questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the purpose of “Type Conversion”?
options: Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.
Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.
Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.

Type Conversion helps keep BSON data consistent across writes and application boundaries. Be deliberate about types, missing fields, explicit nulls, nested values and serialization so queries do not depend on accidental shape differences.
